{"query": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT "Gene" AS ensg,
    CASE WHEN "Cancer" LIKE 'Kidney%' THEN 'Kidney' ELSE 'Lung' END AS cancer,
    "potential prognostic - favorable" AS pf,

    "validated prognostic - favorable" AS vf,

  FROM cancer_prognostic_data
  WHERE "Cancer" IN ('Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)',
                     'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (validation)',
                     'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)',
                     'Lung Adenocarcinoma (validation)')
),
cells AS (
  SELECT ensg, cancer, 'favorable' AS direction, TRY_CAST(pf AS DOUBLE) AS p FROM base WHERE pf IS NOT NULL AND pf <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ensg, cancer, 'unfavorable', TRY_CAST(pu AS DOUBLE) FROM base WHERE pu IS NOT NULL AND pu <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ensg, cancer, 'favorable', TRY_CAST(vf AS DOUBLE) FROM base WHERE vf IS NOT NULL AND vf <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ensg, cancer, 'unfavorable', TRY_CAST(vu AS DOUBLE) FROM base WHERE vu IS NOT NULL AND vu <> ''
),
uni AS (SELECT DISTINCT "Ensembl" AS ensg FROM proteinatlas),
aggr AS (
  SELECT c.ensg,
    MIN(CASE WHEN cancer='Kidney' AND direction='favorable' THEN p END) AS k_fav_p,
    MIN(CASE WHEN cancer='Lung' AND direction='favorable' THEN p END) AS l_fav_p,
    MIN(CASE WHEN cancer='Kidney' AND direction='unfavorable' THEN p END) AS k_un_p,
    MIN(CASE WHEN cancer='Lung' AND direction='unfavorable' THEN p END) AS l_un_p
  FROM cells c JOIN uni u USING(ensg)
  GROUP BY c.ensg
)

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ensg) FROM cells) AS distinct_genes_in_cells_all,
  COUNT(*) AS universe_genes_with_any_association,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_fav_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kidney_fav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kidney_unfav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_fav_p IS NOT NULL OR k_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kidney_prognostic,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l_fav_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lung_fav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lung_unfav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l_fav_p IS NOT NULL OR l_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lung_prognostic,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_fav_p IS NOT NULL AND l_fav_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_fav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_un_p IS NOT NULL AND l_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_unfav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_fav_p IS NOT NULL AND l_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS k_fav_l_un,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_un_p IS NOT NULL AND l_fav_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS k_un_l_fav,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (k_fav_p IS NOT NULL OR k_un_p IS NOT NULL) AND (l_fav_p IS NOT NULL OR l_un_p IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prognostic_in_both_anydir,
  SUM(CASE WHEN k_fav_p IS NOT NULL AND k_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kidney_both_dirs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l_fav_p IS NOT NULL AND l_un_p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lung_both_dirs
FROM aggr"}
